tells: 1. Face close is a game-asset head: waxy uniform orange albedo with no pores or subsurface falloff, flat painted brows, specular dots pasted on lifeless irises, and a mouth that is a dark slit with no teeth or lip moisture (club-4-face.png, centre face)

2. Hard cut-out halo where the in-focus subject meets the blurred background: the DOF is a screen-space blur with a bright fringe around the white blouse and jaw, a classic compositing tell (club-4-face.png, shoulder and hair edge against background)

3. Background crowd is flat black cardboard silhouettes with identical heads and no internal shading, standing like a cut-out layer in the haze (club-1-wide.png and club-2-mid.png, upper half behind the tables)

4. Repeated identities: the same pink tracksuit, teal hoodie, white blouse, purple camisole and blonde bob recur in every frame, and the teal-hoodie man reappears in cap and without; a real club does not clone patrons (club-1-wide.png, club-3-mid.png, front row)

5. Tables and drinks are untextured primitives: perfectly flat brown discs, glowing orange cylinders with no glass, no condensation and no contact shadow under hands or cups, and hands hover on the table rims (club-2-mid.png and club-6-held.png, centre tables)

1. Figures float in the seats: no seat compression, no occlusion or contact shadow between bodies and the red seats, and back-row people look pasted on top of seat backs like sprites (theatre-1-wide.png and theatre-2-mid.png, rows 2-3 centre)

2. Wide shot reads as a lineup: front row seated rigidly upright in identical symmetric knees-together poses, hands placed on knees in mirror pose, lit uniformly like a rendered row (theatre-1-wide.png, lower centre)

3. Face close: plastic skin with smeared texture, yellow-pink painted eyelids, a mouth interior that is a flat dark hole with no teeth, clumped low-poly hair card on the crown, and wire hoop earrings that alias (theatre-4-face.png, centre face and hair)

4. Stray geometry and transparency errors: a pink stick or strap crossing behind the blonde woman, a translucent pale ghostly head and body in row two left, and limbs interpenetrating the neighbours (theatre-2-mid.png and theatre-6-held.png, centre-left row 2 and centre pink diagonal)

5. Backdrop crowd beyond row 4 is dark cutout impostors with identical silhouettes and a uniform blue haze; the lighting has no falloff from the stage and no rim/bounce, so the whole house is lit like a flat ambient fill (theatre-3-mid.png and theatre-5-strip.png, upper half)

1. Bodies interpenetrate and lack chairs: the front row in the held frame is fused into a single overlapping mass (cap man, dark-haired man and blonde merge at the shoulders) and people sit on nothing visible (openmic-6-held.png, centre-left front row)

2. Mouths are black-filled holes with dark lipstick-like edges when laughing; teeth and tongue are missing and lips do not deform with the jaw (openmic-2-mid.png, green-top and dark-hoodie women centre-right)

3. Face close: hair is a rigid helmet with a hard alpha-card fringe and a stray black block behind the ear, skin is smooth and evenly lit with only a painted blush, and the necklace is a flat texture without thickness (openmic-4-face.png, right side of head and neckline)

4. Lighting is a single warm ambient wash: the row of identical round downlight sprites on the wall do not cast pools on the audience, faces get no key/fill ratio, and the bright yellow shirt glows with no shading in the folds (openmic-1-wide.png, upper wall and centre figure)

5. Motion strip: between 0.2 s frames only heads and mouths change, torsos and hands stay locked on the knees, heads snap to new angles rather than following through, and the laugh onset has no shoulder rise or breath (openmic-5-strip.png, all six frames, front row)
